thread:
maria: Heads up — I'm onboarding a new checkpoint 'halcyon-13b' for serving. Current artifacts are a single torch .pt at s3://redwood-weights/halcyon/halcyon-13b/v0.1/checkpoint.pt. Plan: convert -> sharded safetensors, fp16, TP shards=8, validate tokenizer and config, then push to staging model catalog. Need quick checks before I open the PR.
jake: I'll take conversion. Want target dtype = fp16? any preference for fallback to bf16 on dedicated hardware?
maria: Prefer fp16 for CPU/GPU compatibility. If we hit issues we can keep a bf16 variant. Important: keep kv-cache ordering and attention dims consistent with our runtime layout.
chen: Quick Q on TP layout — is this a 1D split across hidden dim (our usual) or anything custom here? also need to know whether query/key/value are packed or separate in the checkpoint.
alex: Standard for us = 1D TP split on hidden_size. We expect q/k/v packed (qkv fused) for perf. If checkpoint has separate q/k/v we'll remap in convert script. See snippet: ```python
# conversion hint
state = torch.load('checkpoint.pt')
# if 'q_proj' in state: pack qkv into single tensor dim=0
```
sarah: Tokenizer check: vocab.json shows BOS token mapped to id 1 (instead of 0). That caused off-by-one in a customer test last week. We should enforce tokenizer_config: {"bos_token_id": 0, "eos_token_id": 2} in the model card unless conversion normalizes it.
maria: Good catch. I'll add a validation step to the script to assert bos_token_id==0 or rewrite offsets. Also need to validate max_position_embeddings (model config says 2048, tokenizer default 1024) — mismatch will break some generation paths.
jake: On conversion script: I'll open a PR to repo infra/model-convert with a smoke test that loads the sharded safetensors and runs a short generate. Any preferences for smoke prompt? "Hello world" minimal.
chen: Smoke prompt fine. Add a tokenization roundtrip test: encode->decode equals original (modulo whitespace) and check that ">" token isn't split weirdly.
ops-bot: CI triggered for branch convert/halcyon-13b — preflight checks running :gear:
deploy-bot: quick note — ensure the model entry in the catalog includes "preferred_layout": "tp1d_shard_hidden", "quant_dtype": "fp16" for autoswap logic.
alex: Also add a field "kv_cache_order": "layer-major" or "shard-major" so serving runtime picks correct cache layout. Default is layer-major for our runtime.
sarah: One more tokenizer quirk: tokenizer.json contains merges that cause unknown tokenization of URLs. Not critical for base serving, but flagging for regtests.
maria: Plan: (1) Jake runs conversion -> sharded safetensors (8 shards) + upload to s3://redwood-weights/halcyon/halcyon-13b/v0.1/safetensors/ (2) PR includes conversion log, tokenizer_fix patch, config normalization, cargo-smoke test. (3) Chen / Alex review TP remapping. (4) Sarah adds tokenizer regtest. (5) After :white_check_mark: smoke, promote to staging catalog.
jake: Starting conversion now, will post upload link when done.
(2h later)
jake: Converted -> fp16 safetensors, 8 shards, uploaded to s3://redwood-weights/halcyon/halcyon-13b/v0.1/safetensors/halcyon-13b-shard-{0..7}.safetensors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-convert/pull/412 — includes tokenizer normalization and config normalization.
chen: Quick review: I checked qkv packing, remapped shapes look correct, TP dims line up. Two minor comments on header naming, sending review now.
alex: Ran the smoke load on staging infra, model loads, kv_cache init passes, generate on short prompt returns plausible tokens. Perf numbers: baseline latency +3% due to fp16 packing but within SLO.
sarah: Added tokenizer regtest, found URL splitting still weird; filed issue #998 and added skip list for tokens. Not blocking.
maria: Awesome. Can we get someone to bless the model card and add preferred routing policy for dedicated vs hosted? jake or alex?
jake: I'll draft the model card and routing suggestion: hosted default -> halcyon-13b-fp16-lowmem, dedicated -> halcyon-13b-fp16-highthr.
ops-bot: Pre-deploy checks green for staging. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Promoting to staging catalog scheduled in 30m window.
maria: Thanks everyone — closing out this handoff. If any regressions pop up, please ping #eng-oncall. :heart:
jake: noted, will monitor logs for first 2 hours.
chen: thanks — leaving a few inline comments on PR. will re-approve after small nits.
alex: lgtm on perf. keep an eye on kv memory during long context runs.
sarah: thanks all :thumbsup:
